paragraphs.text:
“Come  on.”  You  usher  your  companions  forward.  Up  ahead, 
the mineral deposits along the stream are no longer unspoiled. 
The rocks appear to be stripped of their brimstone and artful 
vermiculations.
Make a Listen roll: if you succeed, go to 65; if you fail, go to 104.
